audio.strategy: One AudioContext. Piano Grand, Upright, and Electric play bundled recorded MP3 sample sets (nearest root, two velocity layers, playbackRate for the sounding pitch). Clav, Digital, and Misc are live synthesis. If the recorded library is absent, Grand keeps the Phase 1 additive voice and Upright/Electric use distinct synthesis. If a recorded set fails to load, those three types play a labeled synthesized fallback and the status is fallback, not ready. Each piano layer has its own bus and effect chain. Layer level is applied before the direct/rotary split so two layers stay independent into the shared rotary. Master gain and one limiter feed a single destination.

notes: Grand files are Salamander Grand Piano V3 layers 4 and 13, CC BY 3.0, Alexander Holm. See public/samples/SALAMANDER-LICENSE.txt.

Upright files are Versilian Community Sample Library, CC0 1.0. C6 has no vl1; the soft slot reuses the vl2 take and the manifest says so. rootMidi is the sounding pitch, one octave above the VCSL printed name.
Electric files are jRhodes3d by Jeff Learman, CC BY-NC 4.0. Non-commercial redistribution with attribution.
Organ, Synth, and Program controls remain decorative. The Organ rotary-source button does nothing because there is no organ audio.

Unsupported and still decorative: pedal noise, half-pedaling, Nord Triple Pedal, piano size classes, piano preset library, per-type Variations, Reverb Chorale, delay feedback-loop effects and Analog mode, Mod 1 Pump/Wah pedal modes, rotary close mic and stop angle.
Reverb always precedes the shared rotary. There is no post-rotary reverb.
Soft and sostenuto pedals are not implemented. The sustain button, Space, and MIDI CC64 are the sustain pedal only.
Unison is extra detuned copies inside one voice, not extra polyphony.
Compressor fast mode is the amount knob at 110 or above. There is no separate fast button.
